name: MagicSlides
tagline: MagicSlides is an AI presentation maker that transforms any text, document, or topic into a polished slideshow in seconds. Professionals and students use it as a Google Slides or PowerPoint add-on to generate structured presentations from a prompt or document without building slides manually from scratch. It handles layout, content organization, and design choices automatically, making it useful for quickly creating a first draft that can be refined rather than starting from a blank deck.
